meta.title: La Couvrière · Mountain lodge in Cilaos, Réunion Island
meta.description: Wooden lodge in the Cirque de Cilaos at 1,200 m. Book direct with no commission and a secure online deposit.

hero.tag: Mountain lodge · Cirque de Cilaos · 1,200 m
hero.title: Sleep in the highlands, between clouds and tamarind trees.
hero.text: A wooden lodge opening onto the cirque, steps from the trails. Book direct, no commission, secure online deposit.
hero.illustrationAlt: Illustration of the Cirque de Cilaos mountains at sunrise

gite.title: Timber, a wood stove, and the Piton des Neiges when you wake.
gite.text: A 65 m² chalet built entirely in Japanese cedar, insulated for cool highland nights, designed for four people who want to hike by day and settle in by night.

chalet.title: The chalet
chalet.text: Two bedrooms, a large living room under the rafters, a wood stove for 12 °C evenings and an open kitchen to cook the village lentils.

terrasse.title: The terrace
terrasse.text: Facing west, straight at the Piton des Neiges. Coffee as the mist lifts, drinks at sunset: the two best moments of the day happen here.

jardin.title: The garden
jardin.text: Highland tamarinds, tree ferns and a patch of herbs. A hammock, a barbecue, and the trailhead thirty metres from the gate.

photoAlt.chalet: The wooden chalet at La Couvrière
photoAlt.terrasse: The terrace facing the Piton des Neiges

hauts.title: The highlands, life-size.
hauts.text: Cilaos is the perfect base camp: the big summits start at your door, the thermal baths are in the village, and the food has character.

piton.title: Piton des Neiges
piton.text: The roof of the Indian Ocean (3,071 m). Trailhead at Le Bloc, 15 minutes on foot; overnight at the Caverne Dufour hut and sunrise at the summit.

thermes.title: Cilaos thermal baths
thermes.text: Naturally sparkling hot springs, baths, jets and massages. The best day-after-a-hike there is.

roche.title: Roche Merveilleuse
roche.text: The lookout over the whole cirque and the village. A cedar-forest trail, best at dawn before the mist rolls in.

lentilles.title: Cilaos lentils & wine
lentilles.text: Lentils grown on terraces, Cilaos wine, embroidery. Sunday morning market, producers along the road to Bras-Sec.
